newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Air declines comment on report.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Air declines comment on report.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp declined to comment Monday on a published report that it was close to a deal to buy up to 50 planes from Airbus Industrie .
Earlier, Airbus denied the report that it was close to clinching the deal. "We are in talks with them as with many other companies," an Airbus spokesman said.
The Wall Street Journal reported that Northwest was close to ordering 50 planes from Airbus Industries with a list price value of $2 billion.
The newspaper, quoting people familiar with the talks, said Northwest was in the later stage of negotiations to order 50 narrow-body 125-seat A319s with options on up to 100 more.
If Northwest exercise all the options, the order would have a list price of $6 billion, the newspaper added.
